en: This is a vintage postcard with a decorative green border and the logo 'WIENER WERKSTAETTE' (Vienna Workshop) and number 745. There is a green Austrian postage stamp featuring Emperor Franz Joseph I, valued at 5 Heller, dated 1908. The card is addressed to 'HERRN DR. A. SPITZER, WIEN I., HOHENSTAUFFENG. 17' and contains a handwritten New Year greeting from Egon Schiele, with another lighter note signed by Wally Neuzil. The postmark indicates use in Austria.
